## App launch icon

Selected file: app-icon.png. Built-in image_gen; reference: companion-actions.png. Actual dimensions: 1254 × 1254; RGB, opaque full-square moss-green background. Visually inspected with view_image. The face and ears have safe margins; the chest intentionally continues to the bottom edge. No text, border, grid or corner rounding. Existing selected art remains unchanged.

```text
Use case: illustration-story
Asset type: final original app launch icon for the installable H5 companion experience Roam Atelier.
Input image 1: CHARACTER IDENTITY reference only, the established original cream-and-caramel otter atlas. Use ONE otter matching its exact face, round little ears, warm caramel fur, cream muzzle, small dark brown button nose, dark friendly eyes, subtle whiskers and soft friendly proportions.
Primary request: A superb square app icon, ideally exactly 1024 × 1024 pixels. A close-up of the otter's friendly face and a little cream chest, looking forward with a peaceful welcoming smile. Center the entire head and ears precisely, with generous safe margins so the face remains complete inside common system icon masks. Keep the outermost ears, whiskers and shoulders comfortably inset from the square edges; the face is the clear primary shape and remains readable at tiny app-icon size.
Background: An opaque rich moss-green full-square backdrop, softly hand-painted with very restrained natural pigment texture and a gentle central lift in brightness. The background fills the canvas edge to edge. Do not round the corners; the operating system applies its own mask.
Style/medium: Polished tactile picture-book gouache and delicate natural pencil outlines. Preserve the reference otter's warm cream-and-caramel identity and gentle daylight, with crisp soft silhouette contrast against the moss-green field. Simplify only unnecessary tiny fur detail for small-size clarity, retain expressive face quality.
Constraints: This is an app launch icon, not a social preview or cover. Exactly one head with a little chest. No props, no clothes, no hat, no lettering, no text, no logo marks, no border, no grid, no frame, no watermark. Completely original character and design.
```


Built-in image_gen only. Created 2026-09-10. These prompts describe an original art world and original character. Source images stay in the built-in generated_images directory; selected files are copied into this handoff folder without changing image pixels.

## equipment

```text

Cell order left to right:
TOP ROW col1: a charming straw explorer hat, rounded crown and soft brim, simple moss-green band, front three-quarter view.
TOP ROW col2: a moss-green canvas backpack, softly rounded with caramel straps and flap, three-quarter frontal view.
TOP ROW col3: a coral knitted scarf, open soft neck loop and two small dangling ends, front three-quarter view.
BOTTOM ROW col1: a pale blue rain hat, supple rounded crown and flared waterproof brim, front three-quarter view.
BOTTOM ROW col2: a folded compact brass telescope, beautiful warm brass cylinder with brown leather grip, diagonal orientation.
BOTTOM ROW col3: a cream canvas picnic satchel, boxy yet soft with tan leather straps and small fasteners, three-quarter frontal view.

Soft upper-left natural daylight, modest elevated three-quarter frontal perspective. Coherent artisanal details without visual clutter.
Layout: Exactly THREE equal-width columns × TWO equal-height rows. All six accessories separated and centered with large clean empty margins, each occupying about 62–70% of its cell, no overlap, each complete with nothing clipped. Large readable inventory silhouettes.
Background: ACTUAL FULLY TRANSPARENT BACKGROUND, PNG alpha zero outside each object, preserve clean semi-transparent edge antialiasing. No painted checkerboard, no white rectangle.
Constraints: No animal, no mannequin, no character, no floor, no scene, no cast shadows outside objects, no text, no logos, no letters, no labels, no grid lines, no borders, no watermark. Completely original accessories.
```


## equipment-clean

```text
Use case: background-extraction
Asset type: production transparent PNG sprite atlas.
Input image 1: the EDIT TARGET, an original hand-painted atlas.
Primary request: Remove ALL colored glowing background halos and all background pixels from this image, leaving only the solid painted objects with clean natural edges. Everything outside the actual object silhouettes must have alpha exactly zero. Object interiors should be fully opaque alpha 255; only a narrow edge may have partial alpha for natural antialiasing. No colored fringe, no white or black matte, no glowing haze, no cast shadows. True transparent background, NOT a checkerboard picture.
Preserve the exact original shapes, painterly texture, original colors, shading, intricate details and identities of all objects; do not redesign or change their order. Place every object fully inside its own equal cell with ample padding so native atlas cropping never clips.
No lettering, no grids, no borders, no watermarks.
Keep SIX accessories in THREE columns × TWO rows at 1536×1024. Equal 512×512 cells. Shrink each current item to 70% of its current linear size. Center each horizontally and vertically in its own cell. Order unchanged: top row straw hat, green backpack, coral scarf; bottom row blue rain hat, brass telescope, canvas satchel. Every item must have at least 12% cell-width empty margins, no part touches or crosses a cell boundary.
```
